But if what is meant is that they were the only ones meant and not others, then it is questionable, because there are hadiths that indicate that what is meant is more general than that: The first hadith: Imam Ahmad said: Affan told us, Hammad told us, Ali bin Zaid told us on the authority of Anas bin Malik, may God be pleased with him, who said: “The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, would pass by the door of Fatimah, may God be pleased with her, for six months when he went out to the dawn prayer, saying: ‘Prayer, O people of the House! God only desires to remove from you the impurity, O people of the House, and to purify you with a thorough purification.’” Narrated by Al-Tirmidhi on the authority of Abd bin Hamid on the authority of Affan on his authority. He said: It is hasan gharib. Another hadith Ibn Jarir said: Ibn Wakee’ told us, Abu Na’eem told us, Yunus told us on the authority of Abu Ishaq, Abu Dawud told me on the authority of Abu al-Hamra’ who said: I stayed in Medina for seven months during the time of the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace. He said: “I saw the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, when dawn came, come to the door of Ali and Fatima, may God be pleased with them, and say: Prayer, prayer. God only desires to remove from you the impurity, O people of the House, and to purify you with a thorough purification.” Abu Dawud al-A’ma is Nafi’ ibn al-Harith, a liar. Another hadith Imam Ahmad also said: Muhammad ibn Mus`ab told us, Al-Awza`i told us, Shaddad Abu `Ammar told us: I entered upon Wathilah ibn Al-Asqa` may God be pleased with him, and there were some people with him, so they mentioned Ali may God be pleased with him and cursed him, so he cursed him along with them. When they got up, he said to me: Did you curse this man? I said: They cursed him, so I cursed him along with them. Shall I not tell you what I saw from the Messenger of God (blessings and peace of God be upon him)? I said: Yes. He said: I came to Fatima may God be pleased with her to ask her about Ali may God be pleased with him. She said: Go to the Messenger of God (may God bless him and grant him peace). I sat waiting for him until the Messenger of God (may God bless him and grant him peace) came with Ali, Hasan, and Husayn may God be pleased with them. I took each one of them by the hand until he entered. He brought Ali and Fatima may God be pleased with them closer and seated them in front of him, and seated Hasan and Husayn may God be pleased with them, each one of them on his thigh. Then he wrapped his garment or he said his cloak over them. Then he (may God bless him and grant him peace) recited this verse: God only desires to keep away the uncleanness from you, O people of the House, and to purify you with a thorough purification. And he said: O God, these are my family, and my family is more deserving. Abu Jaafar bin Jarir narrated it on the authority of Abdul Karim bin Abi Umair on the authority of Al-Walid bin Muslim, on the authority of Abu Amr Al-Awza’i, with a similar chain of transmission. He added at the end of it: Wathilah, may God be pleased with him, said: So I said: And I, O Messenger of God, may God bless you, am I part of your family? The Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him) said: And you are one of my family. Wathilah may God be pleased with him said: And it is one of the things I hope for most. Then he also narrated it on the authority of Abd al-A’la ibn Wasil, on the authority of al-Fadl ibn Dukayn, on the authority of Abd al-Salam ibn Harb, on the authority of Kulthum al-Maharibi, on the authority of Shaddad ibn Abi Ammar, who said: “I was sitting with Wathilah ibn al-Asqa’, may God be pleased with him, when they mentioned Ali may God be pleased with him and cursed him. When they stood up, he said: Sit so that I may tell you about the one whom they cursed. I was with the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) when Ali, Fatimah, Hasan, and Husayn may God be pleased with them came. The Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him) threw his cloak over them and said to them: “O God, these are my family. O God, remove uncleanness from them and purify them thoroughly.” I said: O Messenger of God, what about me? The Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him) said: And you? He said: By God, it is the most trustworthy deed for me. Another hadith Imam Ahmad said: Abdullah bin Numayr told us, Abdul Malik bin Abi Sulayman told us, on the authority of Ata bin Abi Rabah, who told me that he heard Umm Salamah, may God be pleased with her, mention that the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, was in her house, and Fatimah, may God be pleased with her, brought him a pot containing saffron. She entered upon him with it, and the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, said to her: Call your husband and your two sons. She said: Then Ali, Hassan, and Hussein, may God be pleased with them, came and entered upon him and sat down to eat from that saffron while he was on his bed, and beneath him, may God bless him and grant him peace, was a Khaybari cloak. She said: And I was in the room praying, and God Almighty revealed this verse: God only desires to keep away the uncleanness from you, O people of the House, and to purify you with a thorough purification. She said, may God be pleased with her: The Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, took the excess cloak and covered them with it, then he put out his hand and waved it towards the sky and said: O God, these are my family and my special ones, so keep away the uncleanness from them and purify them with a thorough purification. She said: So I put my head in the house, and I said: And I With you, O Messenger of God? He, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: You are indeed on the right path, you are indeed on the right path. In its chain of transmission is an unnamed sheikh of Ata’, but the rest of its men are trustworthy. Another chain of transmission Ibn Jarir said: Abu Kurayb narrated to us, Mus`ab ibn al-Miqdad narrated to us, Sa`id ibn Zurbi narrated to us, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Sirin, on the authority of Abu Hurayrah, on the authority of Umm Salamah, may God be pleased with her, who said: “Fatimah, may God be pleased with her, came to the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, with a pot of hers in which she had made porridge, carrying it on a plate. She placed it in front of him, may God bless him and grant him peace, and he said: ‘Where is your cousin and your two sons?’ She, may God be pleased with her, said: ‘In the house.’ He, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: ‘Call them.’ She came to Ali, may God be pleased with him, and said: ‘You and your two sons, answer the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace.’ Umm Salamah, may God be pleased with her, said: ‘When he saw them approaching, the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, reached out to a cloak that was on the bed, extended it, spread it out, and seated them on it. Then he took hold of the four corners of the cloak with his left hand and folded it over their heads. He gestured with his right hand to his Lord and said: ‘O God, these are my family, so remove impurity from them and purify them with a thorough purification.’” Another path Ibn Jarir said: Ibn Hamid told us, Abdullah bin Abdul Quddus told us, on the authority of Al-A’mash, on the authority of Hakim bin Sa’d, who said: We mentioned Ali bin Abi Talib, may God be pleased with him, to Umm Salamah, may God be pleased with her, and she said: In my house, the verse ‘God only desires to keep away the uncleanness from you, O people of the House, and to purify you with a thorough purification’ was revealed. Umm Salamah said: “The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, came to my house and said: Do not allow anyone in. Then Fatimah, may God be pleased with her, came, and I could not prevent her from entering upon her father. Then Al-Hasan, may God be pleased with him, came, and I could not prevent him from entering upon his grandfather and mother. Then Al-Husayn came, and I could not prevent him from entering upon his grandfather, may God bless him and grant him peace, and his mother, may God be pleased with them. Then Ali, may God be pleased with him, came, and I could not prevent him. So they gathered together, and the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, covered them with a cloak he was wearing, then he said: These are my family, so keep away uncleanness from them and purify them with a thorough purification. So this verse was revealed when they gathered on the carpet.” She said: “I said: O Messenger of God, and what about me?” She said: By God, he is not happy, and he said: You are on the right path. Another chain of transmission Imam Ahmad said: Muhammad ibn Ja`far told us, `Awf told us, on the authority of Abu al-Mu`addil, on the authority of `Atiyyah al-Tafawi, on the authority of his father, who said: Umm Salamah, may God be pleased with her, told him: “While the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, was in my house one day, the servant said: ‘Fatima and `Ali, may God be pleased with them, are at the door.’ She said: ‘The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said to me: ‘Get up and move away from my family.’ She said: ‘So I got up and moved away from my family in the house.’ Ali and Fatima entered, and with them were al-Hasan and al-Husayn, may God be pleased with them, and they were two young boys. He took the two boys and placed them in his lap and kissed them. He embraced `Ali, may God be pleased with him, with one hand and `Fatima, may God be pleased with her, with the other. He kissed Fatima and `Ali, and he covered them with a black cloak and said: ‘O God, to You, not to the Fire, me and my family.’ I said: ‘And what about you, O Messenger of God?’ He, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: ‘And you?’” Another chain of transmission Ibn Jarir said: Abu Kurayb told us, Al-Hasan bin Atiyah told us, Fadil bin Marzouq told us, on the authority of Atiyah, on the authority of Abu Saeed, on the authority of Umm Salamah, may God be pleased with her, who said: This verse was revealed in my house: God only desires to keep away the uncleanness from you, O people of the House, and to purify you with a thorough purification. She said: “I was sitting at the door of the house, so I said: O Messenger of God, am I not from the people of the House? He, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: You are indeed on the right path, you are from the wives of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace.” She said: “And in the house were the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, Ali, Fatimah, Al-Hasan, and Al-Hussein, may God be pleased with them.” Another way It was also narrated by Ibn Jarir on the authority of Abu Kurayb on the authority of Wakee’ on the authority of Abd al-Hamid ibn Bahram on the authority of Shahr ibn Hawshab on the authority of Umm Salamah, may God be pleased with her. Another path Ibn Jarir said: Abu Kurayb told us, Khalid bin Mukhallad told us, Musa bin Ya’qub told me, Hashim bin Hashim bin Utbah bin Abi Waqqas told me, on the authority of Abdullah bin Wahb bin Zam’ah, who said: Umm Salamah, may God be pleased with her, told me: “The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, gathered Ali, Fatimah, Al-Hasan, and Al-Hussein, may God be pleased with them, then he brought them under his garment, then he cried out to God Almighty and said: These are my family. Umm Salamah, may God be pleased with her, said: So I said: O Messenger of God, bring me in with them. So he, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: You are from my family.” Another way It was also narrated by Ibn Jarir on the authority of Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Tusi, on the authority of Abd al-Rahman ibn Salih, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Sulayman al-Asbahani, on the authority of Yahya ibn Ubayd al-Makki, on the authority of Ata’, on the authority of Umar ibn Abi Salamah, on the authority of his mother, may God be pleased with her, in a similar manner. Another hadith Ibn Jarir said: We were told by Wakee’ Muhammad ibn Bashir, on the authority of Zakariya, on the authority of Mus’ab ibn Shaybah, on the authority of Safiyyah bint Shaybah, who said: Aisha, may God be pleased with her, said: “The Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, went out one morning wearing a black hair cloak. Al-Hasan, may God be pleased with him, came and he brought him in with him. Then al-Husayn came and he brought him in with him. Then Fatimah came and he brought her in with him. Then Ali, may God be pleased with him, came and he brought him in with him. Then he, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: ‘God only desires to remove from you the impurity, O people of the House, and to purify you with a thorough purification.’” Narrated by Muslim on the authority of Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah on the authority of Muhammad ibn Bashir. Another chain of transmission Ibn Abi Hatim said: My father told us, Surayj bin Yunus Abu Al-Harith told us, Muhammad bin Yazid told us, on the authority of Al-Awam, meaning Ibn Hawshab, may God be pleased with him, on the authority of his uncle, who said: “I entered with my father upon Aisha, may God be pleased with her, and I asked her about Ali, may God be pleased with him. She said, may God be pleased with her: You are asking me about a man who was one of the most beloved people to the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, and who had his daughter under him and was the most beloved person to him? I saw the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, call Ali, Fatima, Hasan, and Husayn, may God be pleased with them, and he threw a garment over them and said: O God, these are my family, so remove impurity from them and purify them thoroughly. She said: So I approached them and said: O Messenger of God, am I one of your family? He, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: Step aside, for you are on the right path.” Another hadith Ibn Jarir said: Ibn Al-Muthanna told us, Bakr bin Yahya bin Zaban Al-Anzi told us, Mandal told us, on the authority of Al-A’mash, on the authority of Atiyyah, on the authority of Abu Sa’id, may God be pleased with him, who said: “The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: This verse was revealed about five: about me, Ali, Hassan, Hussein, and Fatimah: ‘God only desires to remove from you the uncleanness, O people of the House, and to purify you with a thorough purification.’” It was previously mentioned that Fadil bin Marzuq narrated it on the authority of Atiyyah, on the authority of Abu Sa’id, on the authority of Umm Salamah, may God be pleased with her, as previously mentioned. Ibn Abi Hatim narrated from the hadith of Harun bin Sa’d Al-Ajli, on the authority of Atiyyah, on the authority of Abu Sa’id, may God be pleased with him, as a narration that ends with the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace. And God Almighty knows best. Another hadith Ibn Jarir said: Ibn Al-Muthanna told us, Abu Bakr Al-Hanafi told us, Bakir bin Mismar told us: I heard Amer bin Saad, may God be pleased with him, say: Saad, may God be pleased with him, said: “The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said when the revelation came down to him, so he took Ali, his two sons, and Fatima, may God be pleased with them, and brought them under his garment, then he said: O Lord, these are my family and my household.” Another hadith Muslim said in his Sahih: Zuhair bin Harb and Shuja’ bin Mukhallad told me, on the authority of Ibn Ulayyah. Zuhair said: Ismail bin Ibrahim told us, Abu Hayyan told me, Yazid bin Hibban told me: I, Husayn bin Sabra, and Umar bin Maslama went to Zayd bin Arqam, may God be pleased with him. When we sat down with him, Husayn said to him: You have found much good, O Zayd. You saw the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, and heard his hadith. You fought with him and prayed behind him. You have found much good, O Zayd. Tell us, Zaid, what you heard from the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him). He said: O son of my brother, by God, I have grown old and my time has passed, and I have forgotten some of what I used to remember from the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him). So accept what I have told you, and do not burden me with what I have not told you. Then he said: “The Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) stood up among us one day to deliver a sermon at a watering place called Khumm, between Mecca and Medina. He praised God and extolled Him, and preached and reminded. Then he said: As for what follows, O people, I am only a human being. Soon a messenger from my Lord will come to me and I will respond. I am leaving among you two weighty things: The first is the Book of God, in which is guidance and light, so take the Book of God and hold fast to it.” So he urged people to adhere to the Book of God and encouraged them to adhere to it. Then he said: “And the people of my household. I remind you of God regarding the people of my household. I remind you of God regarding the people of my household,” three times. Husayn said to him: And who are the people of his household, Zaid? Aren’t his women among his household? He said: His women are among his household, but the people of his household are those for whom charity is forbidden. He said: And who are they? He said: They are the family of Ali, the family of Aqeel, the family of Jaafar, and the family of Abbas, may God be pleased with them. He said: Is charity forbidden to all of these after them? He said: Yes. Then he narrated it on the authority of Muhammad bin Bakkar bin Al-Rayyan on the authority of Hassan bin Ibrahim on the authority of Saeed bin Masrouq on the authority of Yazid bin Hayyan on the authority of Zaid bin Arqam, may God be pleased with him, and he mentioned the hadith similar to what was mentioned above, and in it I said to him: Are his women from the people of his house? He said: No, by God, a woman may be with a man for an age, then he divorces her and she returns to her father. The people of his house are his origin and his clan who forbade charity after him. This is how it happened in this narration, and the first is better and more appropriate to take it. This second possibility suggests that he wanted to explain the family mentioned in the hadith he narrated, that what is meant by them is his family who were forbidden from charity, or that what is meant by family is not only the wives, but they are with his family, and this possibility is more likely to reconcile them with the narration before it, and also to reconcile the Qur’an and the hadiths that came before it if they are authentic, because there is a problem with some of their chains of transmission, and God knows best. Then what is not in doubt from contemplating the Qur’an is that the wives of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, are included in the words of God Almighty: God only desires to remove from you the uncleanness, O people of the household, and to purify you with a thorough purification, because the context of the speech is with them, and for this reason God Almighty said after all of this: And remember what is recited in your houses of the verses of God and wisdom, meaning, act according to what God Almighty sends down to His Messenger, may God bless him and grant him peace, in your houses from the Book and the Sunnah, as Qatadah and more than one said, and remember this blessing that you were singled out from among the people, that the revelation is sent down in your houses without the rest of the people, and Aisha, the truthful daughter of the truthful, may God be pleased with them both, is the first of them to receive this blessing. And the most fortunate of them in this bounty, and the most special of them in this universal mercy, is that the revelation did not come down to the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) in the bed of any other woman, as stated by God’s prayers and peace be upon him. Some scholars may God have mercy on him said: Because he did not marry a virgin other than her, and no man slept with her in her bed other than him (peace and blessings of God be upon him and may God be pleased with her), it was appropriate that she be singled out for this privilege and this high rank. However, if his wives were from his household, then his relatives are more deserving of this name, as mentioned in the hadith: And my household is more deserving. This is similar to what was proven in Sahih Muslim: “When the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) was asked about the mosque that was founded on piety from the first day, he said: It is this mosque of mine.” This is of this type, for the verse was revealed regarding the mosque of Quba’, as mentioned in other hadiths. However, if that was founded on piety from the first day, then the mosque of the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) is more deserving of this name, and God knows best. Ibn Abi Hatim said: My father told us, Abu Al-Walid told us, Abu Awana told us, on the authority of Hisain bin Abdul Rahman, on the authority of Abu Jamila, who said: Al-Hasan bin Ali may God be pleased with them both was appointed caliph when Ali may God be pleased with them both was killed. He said: While he was praying, a man jumped on him and stabbed him with his dagger. Hisain claimed that he had heard that the one who stabbed him was a man from Banu Asad, and Al-Hasan may God be pleased with him was prostrating. He said: They claim that the stab wound was in his hip, and he was sick for months and then recovered. He sat on the pulpit and said: O people of Iraq, fear God in our regard, for we are your leaders and your guests, and we are the people of the house about whom God the Most High said: God only desires to keep away the uncleanness from you, O people of the house, and to purify you with a thorough purification. He said: He kept saying this until there was no one in the mosque who did not cry and wail. Al-Suddi narrated on the authority of Abu Al-Daylam that he said: Ali bin Al-Hussein may God be pleased with him said to a man from Ash-Sham: Have you not read in al-Ahzab 33:God only desires to keep away the uncleanness from you, O people of the House, and to purify you with a thorough purification? He said: Yes, and you are them? He said: Yes. And the Almighty’s saying: Indeed, God is ever Kind and Aware means that it is through His kindness to you that you have attained this status, and through His knowledge of you and that you are worthy of that, He gave that to you and singled you out for it. Ibn Jarir may God have mercy on him said: And remember the blessing of God upon you by placing you in homes in which the verses of God and wisdom are recited, so thank God for that and praise Him. Indeed, God is ever Kind and Aware meaning that He was kind to you, as He placed you in homes in which the verses of God and wisdom are recited, and this is the Sunnah. He is Aware of you as He chose you for His Messenger. Qatada said: And remember what is recited in your houses of the verses of God and wisdom He said: He bestows that favor upon them. Narrated by Ibn Jarir. Atiyah Al-Awfi said about the Almighty’s saying: Indeed, God is Kind and All-Knowing, meaning that He is Kind in extracting it and All-Knowing in its location. Narrated by Ibn Abi Hatim, then he said: And it was also narrated on the authority of Al-Rabi’ bin Anas on the authority of Qatada.
33:33: These are the manners that God the Most High commanded the wives of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, to follow, and the women of the ummah follow them in that. So God the Most High said, addressing the wives of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, that if they fear God the Almighty as He commanded them, then no other woman will be like them or reach them in virtue and status. Then God the Most High said: So do not speak in a soft voice. Al-Suddi and others said: By that, he means softening the speech when addressing men. For this reason, God the Most High said: lest he in whose heart is a disease should covet meaning deceit. And speak in appropriate speech. Ibn Zayd said: Good, beautiful, and well-known words of goodness. The meaning of this is that she should address strangers with speech that is not softened, meaning that a woman should not address strangers as she addresses her husband. God the Almighty said: And abide in your houses meaning the time, so do not go out except for a need. Among the legitimate needs is praying in the mosque, provided that it is permissible, as the Messenger of God (blessings and peace of God be upon him) said: Do not prevent the female servants of God from the mosques of God, and let them go out without decency. In another narration: And their homes are better for them. Al-Hafiz Abu Bakr al-Bazzar said: Hamid ibn Mas’adah told us, Abu Raja’ al-Kalbi told us, Ruh ibn al-Musayyab is trustworthy, Thabit al-Banani told us, on the authority of Anas may God be pleased with him, who said: “Women came to the Messenger of God (blessings and peace of God be upon him) and said: O Messenger of God, the men have taken the virtue and jihad in the cause of God, so what work do we have that will equal the work of those who strive in the cause of God? The Messenger of God (blessings and peace of God be upon him) said: Whoever among you stays in her house - or a word similar to that - will attain the work of those who strive in the cause of God.” Then he said: We do not know of anyone who narrated it from Thabit except Ruh ibn al-Musayyab, and he is a well-known man from Basra. Al-Bazzar also said: Muhammad Al-Muthanna told us, Amr bin Asim told me, Hammam told us, on the authority of Qatadah, on the authority of Mawariq, on the authority of Abu Al-Ahwas, on the authority of Abdullah may God be pleased with him, on the authority of the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him), who said: “A woman is ‘awrah, and when she goes out, Satan makes her look suspiciously. She is closest to the spirit of her Lord when she is in the depths of her home.” Narrated by Al-Tirmidhi on the authority of Bandar on the authority of Amr bin Asim, with a similar chain of transmission. Al-Bazzar narrated with his chain of transmission mentioned above, and Abu Dawud also narrated on the authority of the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him), who said: A woman’s prayer in her bedroom is better than her prayer in her house, and her prayer in her house is better than her prayer in her room. This is a good chain of transmission. God the Almighty said: {And do not display yourselves like that of the times of the former ignorance}. Mujahid said: A woman would go out walking in front of men, and that was the display of the times of ignorance. Qatada said: {And do not display yourselves like that of the times of the former ignorance} meaning: If you go out of your houses and they walk gracefully and flirtatiously, then God the Almighty forbade that. Muqatil ibn Hayyan said: {And do not display yourselves like that of the times of the former ignorance}. Displaying yourselves means that she puts the veil over her head and does not tighten it, so that it covers her necklaces, earrings and neck, and all of that is visible from her, and that is the display of her beauty. Then the women of the believers became widespread in display of their beauty. Ibn Jarir said: Ibn Zuhair told me, Musa ibn Ismail told us, Dawud ibn Abi al-Furat told us, Ali ibn Ahmar told us, on the authority of Ikrimah, on the authority of Ibn Abbas, may God be pleased with them both, who said: He recited this verse: And do not display yourselves like that of the times of the former ignorance. He said: It was between Noah and Idris, and it was a thousand years, and there were two clans of the children of Adam, one of them lived in the plain and the other lived in the mountains, and the men of the mountains were beautiful, but the women were ugly. The women of the plain were beautiful in the morning, while the men were ugly. Satan, may God curse him, came to a man from the plain in the form of a boy, and hired himself out to him, so he served him. Satan took something like the symbolism of the shepherds, and he came in it with a voice that people had never heard the like of. This reached those around him, so they came back to listen to him, and they made a festival to which they would gather throughout the year, so the women would display themselves for the men, and the men would adorn themselves for them. A man from the mountain attacked them on their festival, and he saw the women and their beauty, so he came to his companions and informed them of that, so they turned to them and descended with them, and indecency appeared among them, as is the saying of God Almighty: And do not display yourselves like that of the times of the first ignorance. God the Almighty said: {And establish prayer and give zakat and obey God and His Messenger} He first forbade them from evil and then ordered them to do good, such as establishing prayer, which is the worship of God alone with no partner, and giving zakat, which is kindness to creation. And obey God and His Messenger This is a case of linking the general to the specific. God the Almighty said: {God only desires to keep away the uncleanness from you, O people of the Household, and to purify you with a thorough purification} This is a clear statement that the wives of the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him) are included among the people of the household here, because they are the reason for the revelation of this verse, and the reason for revelation is included in it according to one opinion, either on its own according to one opinion, or with something else according to the correct opinion. Ibn Jarir narrated on the authority of Ikrimah that he used to call out in the marketplace: {God only desires to keep away the uncleanness from you, O people of the Household, and to purify you with a thorough purification} It was revealed specifically about the wives of the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him). Thus, Ibn Abi Hatim narrated: Ali bin Harb Al-Mawsili told us, Zaid bin Al-Habbab told us, Hussain bin Waqid told us, on the authority of Yazid Al-Nahwi, on the authority of Ikrimah, on the authority of Ibn Abbas, may God be pleased with them both, regarding the verse: God only desires to keep away the uncleanness from you, O people of the House, he said: It was revealed specifically regarding the wives of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace. Ikrimah said: Whoever wants to know about his family, it was revealed concerning the wives of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace. If what is meant is that they were the reason for the revelation and not others, then it is correct. But if what is meant is that they were the only ones meant and not others, then it is questionable, because there are hadiths that indicate that what is meant is more general than that: The first hadith: Imam Ahmad said: Affan told us, Hammad told us, Ali bin Zaid told us on the authority of Anas bin Malik, may God be pleased with him, who said: “The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, would pass by the door of Fatimah, may God be pleased with her, for six months when he went out to the dawn prayer, saying: ‘Prayer, O people of the House! God only desires to remove from you the impurity, O people of the House, and to purify you with a thorough purification.’” Narrated by Al-Tirmidhi on the authority of Abd bin Hamid on the authority of Affan on his authority. He said: It is hasan gharib. Another hadith Ibn Jarir said: Ibn Wakee’ told us, Abu Na’eem told us, Yunus told us on the authority of Abu Ishaq, Abu Dawud told me on the authority of Abu al-Hamra’ who said: I stayed in Medina for seven months during the time of the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace. He said: “I saw the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, when dawn came, come to the door of Ali and Fatima, may God be pleased with them, and say: Prayer, prayer. God only desires to remove from you the impurity, O people of the House, and to purify you with a thorough purification.” Abu Dawud al-A’ma is Nafi’ ibn al-Harith, a liar. Another hadith Imam Ahmad also said: Muhammad ibn Mus`ab told us, Al-Awza`i told us, Shaddad Abu `Ammar told us: I entered upon Wathilah ibn Al-Asqa` may God be pleased with him, and there were some people with him, so they mentioned Ali may God be pleased with him and cursed him, so he cursed him along with them. When they got up, he said to me: Did you curse this man? I said: They cursed him, so I cursed him along with them. Shall I not tell you what I saw from the Messenger of God (blessings and peace of God be upon him)? I said: Yes. He said: I came to Fatima may God be pleased with her to ask her about Ali may God be pleased with him. She said: Go to the Messenger of God (may God bless him and grant him peace). I sat waiting for him until the Messenger of God (may God bless him and grant him peace) came with Ali, Hasan, and Husayn may God be pleased with them. I took each one of them by the hand until he entered. He brought Ali and Fatima may God be pleased with them closer and seated them in front of him, and seated Hasan and Husayn may God be pleased with them, each one of them on his thigh. Then he wrapped his garment or he said his cloak over them. Then he (may God bless him and grant him peace) recited this verse: God only desires to keep away the uncleanness from you, O people of the House, and to purify you with a thorough purification. And he said: O God, these are my family, and my family is more deserving. Abu Jaafar bin Jarir narrated it on the authority of Abdul Karim bin Abi Umair on the authority of Al-Walid bin Muslim, on the authority of Abu Amr Al-Awza’i, with a similar chain of transmission. He added at the end of it: Wathilah, may God be pleased with him, said: So I said: And I, O Messenger of God, may God bless you, am I part of your family? The Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him) said: And you are one of my family. Wathilah may God be pleased with him said: And it is one of the things I hope for most. Then he also narrated it on the authority of Abd al-A’la ibn Wasil, on the authority of al-Fadl ibn Dukayn, on the authority of Abd al-Salam ibn Harb, on the authority of Kulthum al-Maharibi, on the authority of Shaddad ibn Abi Ammar, who said: “I was sitting with Wathilah ibn al-Asqa’, may God be pleased with him, when they mentioned Ali may God be pleased with him and cursed him. When they stood up, he said: Sit so that I may tell you about the one whom they cursed. I was with the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) when Ali, Fatimah, Hasan, and Husayn may God be pleased with them came. The Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him) threw his cloak over them and said to them: “O God, these are my family. O God, remove uncleanness from them and purify them thoroughly.” I said: O Messenger of God, what about me? The Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him) said: And you? He said: By God, it is the most trustworthy deed for me. Another hadith Imam Ahmad said: Abdullah bin Numayr told us, Abdul Malik bin Abi Sulayman told us, on the authority of Ata bin Abi Rabah, who told me that he heard Umm Salamah, may God be pleased with her, mention that the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, was in her house, and Fatimah, may God be pleased with her, brought him a pot containing saffron. She entered upon him with it, and the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, said to her: Call your husband and your two sons. She said: Then Ali, Hassan, and Hussein, may God be pleased with them, came and entered upon him and sat down to eat from that saffron while he was on his bed, and beneath him, may God bless him and grant him peace, was a Khaybari cloak. She said: And I was in the room praying, and God Almighty revealed this verse: God only desires to keep away the uncleanness from you, O people of the House, and to purify you with a thorough purification. She said, may God be pleased with her: The Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, took the excess cloak and covered them with it, then he put out his hand and waved it towards the sky and said: O God, these are my family and my special ones, so keep away the uncleanness from them and purify them with a thorough purification. She said: So I put my head in the house, and I said: And I With you, O Messenger of God? He, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: You are indeed on the right path, you are indeed on the right path. In its chain of transmission is an unnamed sheikh of Ata’, but the rest of its men are trustworthy. Another chain of transmission Ibn Jarir said: Abu Kurayb narrated to us, Mus`ab ibn al-Miqdad narrated to us, Sa`id ibn Zurbi narrated to us, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Sirin, on the authority of Abu Hurayrah, on the authority of Umm Salamah, may God be pleased with her, who said: “Fatimah, may God be pleased with her, came to the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, with a pot of hers in which she had made porridge, carrying it on a plate. She placed it in front of him, may God bless him and grant him peace, and he said: ‘Where is your cousin and your two sons?’ She, may God be pleased with her, said: ‘In the house.’ He, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: ‘Call them.’ She came to Ali, may God be pleased with him, and said: ‘You and your two sons, answer the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace.’ Umm Salamah, may God be pleased with her, said: ‘When he saw them approaching, the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, reached out to a cloak that was on the bed, extended it, spread it out, and seated them on it. Then he took hold of the four corners of the cloak with his left hand and folded it over their heads. He gestured with his right hand to his Lord and said: ‘O God, these are my family, so remove impurity from them and purify them with a thorough purification.’” Another path Ibn Jarir said: Ibn Hamid told us, Abdullah bin Abdul Quddus told us, on the authority of Al-A’mash, on the authority of Hakim bin Sa’d, who said: We mentioned Ali bin Abi Talib, may God be pleased with him, to Umm Salamah, may God be pleased with her, and she said: In my house, the verse ‘God only desires to keep away the uncleanness from you, O people of the House, and to purify you with a thorough purification’ was revealed. Umm Salamah said: “The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, came to my house and said: Do not allow anyone in. Then Fatimah, may God be pleased with her, came, and I could not prevent her from entering upon her father. Then Al-Hasan, may God be pleased with him, came, and I could not prevent him from entering upon his grandfather and mother. Then Al-Husayn came, and I could not prevent him from entering upon his grandfather, may God bless him and grant him peace, and his mother, may God be pleased with them. Then Ali, may God be pleased with him, came, and I could not prevent him. So they gathered together, and the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, covered them with a cloak he was wearing, then he said: These are my family, so keep away uncleanness from them and purify them with a thorough purification. So this verse was revealed when they gathered on the carpet.” She said: “I said: O Messenger of God, and what about me?” She said: By God, he is not happy, and he said: You are on the right path. Another chain of transmission Imam Ahmad said: Muhammad ibn Ja`far told us, `Awf told us, on the authority of Abu al-Mu`addil, on the authority of `Atiyyah al-Tafawi, on the authority of his father, who said: Umm Salamah, may God be pleased with her, told him: “While the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, was in my house one day, the servant said: ‘Fatima and `Ali, may God be pleased with them, are at the door.’ She said: ‘The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said to me: ‘Get up and move away from my family.’ She said: ‘So I got up and moved away from my family in the house.’ Ali and Fatima entered, and with them were al-Hasan and al-Husayn, may God be pleased with them, and they were two young boys. He took the two boys and placed them in his lap and kissed them. He embraced `Ali, may God be pleased with him, with one hand and `Fatima, may God be pleased with her, with the other. He kissed Fatima and `Ali, and he covered them with a black cloak and said: ‘O God, to You, not to the Fire, me and my family.’ I said: ‘And what about you, O Messenger of God?’ He, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: ‘And you?’” Another chain of transmission Ibn Jarir said: Abu Kurayb told us, Al-Hasan bin Atiyah told us, Fadil bin Marzouq told us, on the authority of Atiyah, on the authority of Abu Saeed, on the authority of Umm Salamah, may God be pleased with her, who said: This verse was revealed in my house: God only desires to keep away the uncleanness from you, O people of the House, and to purify you with a thorough purification. She said: “I was sitting at the door of the house, so I said: O Messenger of God, am I not from the people of the House? He, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: You are indeed on the right path, you are from the wives of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace.” She said: “And in the house were the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, Ali, Fatimah, Al-Hasan, and Al-Hussein, may God be pleased with them.” Another way It was also narrated by Ibn Jarir on the authority of Abu Kurayb on the authority of Wakee’ on the authority of Abd al-Hamid ibn Bahram on the authority of Shahr ibn Hawshab on the authority of Umm Salamah, may God be pleased with her. Another path Ibn Jarir said: Abu Kurayb told us, Khalid bin Mukhallad told us, Musa bin Ya’qub told me, Hashim bin Hashim bin Utbah bin Abi Waqqas told me, on the authority of Abdullah bin Wahb bin Zam’ah, who said: Umm Salamah, may God be pleased with her, told me: “The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, gathered Ali, Fatimah, Al-Hasan, and Al-Hussein, may God be pleased with them, then he brought them under his garment, then he cried out to God Almighty and said: These are my family. Umm Salamah, may God be pleased with her, said: So I said: O Messenger of God, bring me in with them. So he, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: You are from my family.” Another way It was also narrated by Ibn Jarir on the authority of Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Tusi, on the authority of Abd al-Rahman ibn Salih, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Sulayman al-Asbahani, on the authority of Yahya ibn Ubayd al-Makki, on the authority of Ata’, on the authority of Umar ibn Abi Salamah, on the authority of his mother, may God be pleased with her, in a similar manner. Another hadith Ibn Jarir said: We were told by Wakee’ Muhammad ibn Bashir, on the authority of Zakariya, on the authority of Mus’ab ibn Shaybah, on the authority of Safiyyah bint Shaybah, who said: Aisha, may God be pleased with her, said: “The Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, went out one morning wearing a black hair cloak. Al-Hasan, may God be pleased with him, came and he brought him in with him. Then al-Husayn came and he brought him in with him. Then Fatimah came and he brought her in with him. Then Ali, may God be pleased with him, came and he brought him in with him. Then he, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: ‘God only desires to remove from you the impurity, O people of the House, and to purify you with a thorough purification.’” Narrated by Muslim on the authority of Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah on the authority of Muhammad ibn Bashir. Another chain of transmission Ibn Abi Hatim said: My father told us, Surayj bin Yunus Abu Al-Harith told us, Muhammad bin Yazid told us, on the authority of Al-Awam, meaning Ibn Hawshab, may God be pleased with him, on the authority of his uncle, who said: “I entered with my father upon Aisha, may God be pleased with her, and I asked her about Ali, may God be pleased with him. She said, may God be pleased with her: You are asking me about a man who was one of the most beloved people to the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, and who had his daughter under him and was the most beloved person to him? I saw the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, call Ali, Fatima, Hasan, and Husayn, may God be pleased with them, and he threw a garment over them and said: O God, these are my family, so remove impurity from them and purify them thoroughly. She said: So I approached them and said: O Messenger of God, am I one of your family? He, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: Step aside, for you are on the right path.” Another hadith Ibn Jarir said: Ibn Al-Muthanna told us, Bakr bin Yahya bin Zaban Al-Anzi told us, Mandal told us, on the authority of Al-A’mash, on the authority of Atiyyah, on the authority of Abu Sa’id, may God be pleased with him, who said: “The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: This verse was revealed about five: about me, Ali, Hassan, Hussein, and Fatimah: ‘God only desires to remove from you the uncleanness, O people of the House, and to purify you with a thorough purification.’” It was previously mentioned that Fadil bin Marzuq narrated it on the authority of Atiyyah, on the authority of Abu Sa’id, on the authority of Umm Salamah, may God be pleased with her, as previously mentioned. Ibn Abi Hatim narrated from the hadith of Harun bin Sa’d Al-Ajli, on the authority of Atiyyah, on the authority of Abu Sa’id, may God be pleased with him, as a narration that ends with the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace. And God Almighty knows best. Another hadith Ibn Jarir said: Ibn Al-Muthanna told us, Abu Bakr Al-Hanafi told us, Bakir bin Mismar told us: I heard Amer bin Saad, may God be pleased with him, say: Saad, may God be pleased with him, said: “The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said when the revelation came down to him, so he took Ali, his two sons, and Fatima, may God be pleased with them, and brought them under his garment, then he said: O Lord, these are my family and my household.” Another hadith Muslim said in his Sahih: Zuhair bin Harb and Shuja’ bin Mukhallad told me, on the authority of Ibn Ulayyah. Zuhair said: Ismail bin Ibrahim told us, Abu Hayyan told me, Yazid bin Hibban told me: I, Husayn bin Sabra, and Umar bin Maslama went to Zayd bin Arqam, may God be pleased with him. When we sat down with him, Husayn said to him: You have found much good, O Zayd. You saw the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, and heard his hadith. You fought with him and prayed behind him. You have found much good, O Zayd. Tell us, Zaid, what you heard from the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him). He said: O son of my brother, by God, I have grown old and my time has passed, and I have forgotten some of what I used to remember from the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him). So accept what I have told you, and do not burden me with what I have not told you. Then he said: “The Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) stood up among us one day to deliver a sermon at a watering place called Khumm, between Mecca and Medina. He praised God and extolled Him, and preached and reminded. Then he said: As for what follows, O people, I am only a human being. Soon a messenger from my Lord will come to me and I will respond. I am leaving among you two weighty things: The first is the Book of God, in which is guidance and light, so take the Book of God and hold fast to it.” So he urged people to adhere to the Book of God and encouraged them to adhere to it. Then he said: “And the people of my household. I remind you of God regarding the people of my household. I remind you of God regarding the people of my household,” three times. Husayn said to him: And who are the people of his household, Zaid? Aren’t his women among his household? He said: His women are among his household, but the people of his household are those for whom charity is forbidden. He said: And who are they? He said: They are the family of Ali, the family of Aqeel, the family of Jaafar, and the family of Abbas, may God be pleased with them. He said: Is charity forbidden to all of these after them? He said: Yes. Then he narrated it on the authority of Muhammad bin Bakkar bin Al-Rayyan on the authority of Hassan bin Ibrahim on the authority of Saeed bin Masrouq on the authority of Yazid bin Hayyan on the authority of Zaid bin Arqam, may God be pleased with him, and he mentioned the hadith similar to what was mentioned above, and in it I said to him: Are his women from the people of his house? He said: No, by God, a woman may be with a man for an age, then he divorces her and she returns to her father. The people of his house are his origin and his clan who forbade charity after him. This is how it happened in this narration, and the first is better and more appropriate to take it. This second possibility suggests that he wanted to explain the family mentioned in the hadith he narrated, that what is meant by them is his family who were forbidden from charity, or that what is meant by family is not only the wives, but they are with his family, and this possibility is more likely to reconcile them with the narration before it, and also to reconcile the Qur’an and the hadiths that came before it if they are authentic, because there is a problem with some of their chains of transmission, and God knows best. Then what is not in doubt from contemplating the Qur’an is that the wives of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, are included in the words of God Almighty: God only desires to remove from you the uncleanness, O people of the household, and to purify you with a thorough purification, because the context of the speech is with them, and for this reason God Almighty said after all of this: And remember what is recited in your houses of the verses of God and wisdom, meaning, act according to what God Almighty sends down to His Messenger, may God bless him and grant him peace, in your houses from the Book and the Sunnah, as Qatadah and more than one said, and remember this blessing that you were singled out from among the people, that the revelation is sent down in your houses without the rest of the people, and Aisha, the truthful daughter of the truthful, may God be pleased with them both, is the first of them to receive this blessing. And the most fortunate of them in this bounty, and the most special of them in this universal mercy, is that the revelation did not come down to the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) in the bed of any other woman, as stated by God’s prayers and peace be upon him. Some scholars may God have mercy on him said: Because he did not marry a virgin other than her, and no man slept with her in her bed other than him (peace and blessings of God be upon him and may God be pleased with her), it was appropriate that she be singled out for this privilege and this high rank. However, if his wives were from his household, then his relatives are more deserving of this name, as mentioned in the hadith: And my household is more deserving. This is similar to what was proven in Sahih Muslim: “When the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) was asked about the mosque that was founded on piety from the first day, he said: It is this mosque of mine.” This is of this type, for the verse was revealed regarding the mosque of Quba’, as mentioned in other hadiths. However, if that was founded on piety from the first day, then the mosque of the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) is more deserving of this name, and God knows best. Ibn Abi Hatim said: My father told us, Abu Al-Walid told us, Abu Awana told us, on the authority of Hisain bin Abdul Rahman, on the authority of Abu Jamila, who said: Al-Hasan bin Ali may God be pleased with them both was appointed caliph when Ali may God be pleased with them both was killed. He said: While he was praying, a man jumped on him and stabbed him with his dagger. Hisain claimed that he had heard that the one who stabbed him was a man from Banu Asad, and Al-Hasan may God be pleased with him was prostrating. He said: They claim that the stab wound was in his hip, and he was sick for months and then recovered. He sat on the pulpit and said: O people of Iraq, fear God in our regard, for we are your leaders and your guests, and we are the people of the house about whom God the Most High said: God only desires to keep away the uncleanness from you, O people of the house, and to purify you with a thorough purification. He said: He kept saying this until there was no one in the mosque who did not cry and wail. Al-Suddi narrated on the authority of Abu Al-Daylam that he said: Ali bin Al-Hussein may God be pleased with him said to a man from Ash-Sham: Have you not read in al-Ahzab 33:God only desires to keep away the uncleanness from you, O people of the House, and to purify you with a thorough purification? He said: Yes, and you are them? He said: Yes. And the Almighty’s saying: Indeed, God is ever Kind and Aware means that it is through His kindness to you that you have attained this status, and through His knowledge of you and that you are worthy of that, He gave that to you and singled you out for it. Ibn Jarir may God have mercy on him said: And remember the blessing of God upon you by placing you in homes in which the verses of God and wisdom are recited, so thank God for that and praise Him. Indeed, God is ever Kind and Aware meaning that He was kind to you, as He placed you in homes in which the verses of God and wisdom are recited, and this is the Sunnah. He is Aware of you as He chose you for His Messenger. Qatada said: And remember what is recited in your houses of the verses of God and wisdom He said: He bestows that favor upon them. Narrated by Ibn Jarir. Atiyah Al-Awfi said about the Almighty’s saying: Indeed, God is Kind and All-Knowing, meaning that He is Kind in extracting it and All-Knowing in its location. Narrated by Ibn Abi Hatim, then he said: And it was also narrated on the authority of Al-Rabi’ bin Anas on the authority of Qatada.
33:34: These are the manners that God the Most High commanded the wives of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, to follow, and the women of the ummah follow them in that. So God the Most High said, addressing the wives of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, that if they fear God the Almighty as He commanded them, then no other woman will be like them or reach them in virtue and status. Then God the Most High said: So do not speak in a soft voice. Al-Suddi and others said: By that, he means softening the speech when addressing men. For this reason, God the Most High said: lest he in whose heart is a disease should covet meaning deceit. And speak in appropriate speech. Ibn Zayd said: Good, beautiful, and well-known words of goodness. The meaning of this is that she should address strangers with speech that is not softened, meaning that a woman should not address strangers as she addresses her husband. God the Almighty said: And abide in your houses meaning the time, so do not go out except for a need. Among the legitimate needs is praying in the mosque, provided that it is permissible, as the Messenger of God (blessings and peace of God be upon him) said: Do not prevent the female servants of God from the mosques of God, and let them go out without decency. In another narration: And their homes are better for them. Al-Hafiz Abu Bakr al-Bazzar said: Hamid ibn Mas’adah told us, Abu Raja’ al-Kalbi told us, Ruh ibn al-Musayyab is trustworthy, Thabit al-Banani told us, on the authority of Anas may God be pleased with him, who said: “Women came to the Messenger of God (blessings and peace of God be upon him) and said: O Messenger of God, the men have taken the virtue and jihad in the cause of God, so what work do we have that will equal the work of those who strive in the cause of God? The Messenger of God (blessings and peace of God be upon him) said: Whoever among you stays in her house - or a word similar to that - will attain the work of those who strive in the cause of God.” Then he said: We do not know of anyone who narrated it from Thabit except Ruh ibn al-Musayyab, and he is a well-known man from Basra. Al-Bazzar also said: Muhammad Al-Muthanna told us, Amr bin Asim told me, Hammam told us, on the authority of Qatadah, on the authority of Mawariq, on the authority of Abu Al-Ahwas, on the authority of Abdullah may God be pleased with him, on the authority of the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him), who said: “A woman is ‘awrah, and when she goes out, Satan makes her look suspiciously. She is closest to the spirit of her Lord when she is in the depths of her home.” Narrated by Al-Tirmidhi on the authority of Bandar on the authority of Amr bin Asim, with a similar chain of transmission. Al-Bazzar narrated with his chain of transmission mentioned above, and Abu Dawud also narrated on the authority of the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him), who said: A woman’s prayer in her bedroom is better than her prayer in her house, and her prayer in her house is better than her prayer in her room. This is a good chain of transmission. God the Almighty said: {And do not display yourselves like that of the times of the former ignorance}. Mujahid said: A woman would go out walking in front of men, and that was the display of the times of ignorance. Qatada said: {And do not display yourselves like that of the times of the former ignorance} meaning: If you go out of your houses and they walk gracefully and flirtatiously, then God the Almighty forbade that. Muqatil ibn Hayyan said: {And do not display yourselves like that of the times of the former ignorance}. Displaying yourselves means that she puts the veil over her head and does not tighten it, so that it covers her necklaces, earrings and neck, and all of that is visible from her, and that is the display of her beauty. Then the women of the believers became widespread in display of their beauty. Ibn Jarir said: Ibn Zuhair told me, Musa ibn Ismail told us, Dawud ibn Abi al-Furat told us, Ali ibn Ahmar told us, on the authority of Ikrimah, on the authority of Ibn Abbas, may God be pleased with them both, who said: He recited this verse: And do not display yourselves like that of the times of the former ignorance. He said: It was between Noah and Idris, and it was a thousand years, and there were two clans of the children of Adam, one of them lived in the plain and the other lived in the mountains, and the men of the mountains were beautiful, but the women were ugly. The women of the plain were beautiful in the morning, while the men were ugly. Satan, may God curse him, came to a man from the plain in the form of a boy, and hired himself out to him, so he served him. Satan took something like the symbolism of the shepherds, and he came in it with a voice that people had never heard the like of. This reached those around him, so they came back to listen to him, and they made a festival to which they would gather throughout the year, so the women would display themselves for the men, and the men would adorn themselves for them. A man from the mountain attacked them on their festival, and he saw the women and their beauty, so he came to his companions and informed them of that, so they turned to them and descended with them, and indecency appeared among them, as is the saying of God Almighty: And do not display yourselves like that of the times of the first ignorance. God the Almighty said: {And establish prayer and give zakat and obey God and His Messenger} He first forbade them from evil and then ordered them to do good, such as establishing prayer, which is the worship of God alone with no partner, and giving zakat, which is kindness to creation. And obey God and His Messenger This is a case of linking the general to the specific. God the Almighty said: {God only desires to keep away the uncleanness from you, O people of the Household, and to purify you with a thorough purification} This is a clear statement that the wives of the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him) are included among the people of the household here, because they are the reason for the revelation of this verse, and the reason for revelation is included in it according to one opinion, either on its own according to one opinion, or with something else according to the correct opinion. Ibn Jarir narrated on the authority of Ikrimah that he used to call out in the marketplace: {God only desires to keep away the uncleanness from you, O people of the Household, and to purify you with a thorough purification} It was revealed specifically about the wives of the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him). Thus, Ibn Abi Hatim narrated: Ali bin Harb Al-Mawsili told us, Zaid bin Al-Habbab told us, Hussain bin Waqid told us, on the authority of Yazid Al-Nahwi, on the authority of Ikrimah, on the authority of Ibn Abbas, may God be pleased with them both, regarding the verse: God only desires to keep away the uncleanness from you, O people of the House, he said: It was revealed specifically regarding the wives of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace. Ikrimah said: Whoever wants to know about his family, it was revealed concerning the wives of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace. If what is meant is that they were the reason for the revelation and not others, then it is correct. But if what is meant is that they were the only ones meant and not others, then it is questionable, because there are hadiths that indicate that what is meant is more general than that: The first hadith: Imam Ahmad said: Affan told us, Hammad told us, Ali bin Zaid told us on the authority of Anas bin Malik, may God be pleased with him, who said: “The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, would pass by the door of Fatimah, may God be pleased with her, for six months when he went out to the dawn prayer, saying: ‘Prayer, O people of the House! God only desires to remove from you the impurity, O people of the House, and to purify you with a thorough purification.’” Narrated by Al-Tirmidhi on the authority of Abd bin Hamid on the authority of Affan on his authority. He said: It is hasan gharib. Another hadith Ibn Jarir said: Ibn Wakee’ told us, Abu Na’eem told us, Yunus told us on the authority of Abu Ishaq, Abu Dawud told me on the authority of Abu al-Hamra’ who said: I stayed in Medina for seven months during the time of the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace. He said: “I saw the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, when dawn came, come to the door of Ali and Fatima, may God be pleased with them, and say: Prayer, prayer. God only desires to remove from you the impurity, O people of the House, and to purify you with a thorough purification.” Abu Dawud al-A’ma is Nafi’ ibn al-Harith, a liar. Another hadith Imam Ahmad also said: Muhammad ibn Mus`ab told us, Al-Awza`i told us, Shaddad Abu `Ammar told us: I entered upon Wathilah ibn Al-Asqa` may God be pleased with him, and there were some people with him, so they mentioned Ali may God be pleased with him and cursed him, so he cursed him along with them. When they got up, he said to me: Did you curse this man? I said: They cursed him, so I cursed him along with them. Shall I not tell you what I saw from the Messenger of God (blessings and peace of God be upon him)? I said: Yes. He said: I came to Fatima may God be pleased with her to ask her about Ali may God be pleased with him. She said: Go to the Messenger of God (may God bless him and grant him peace). I sat waiting for him until the Messenger of God (may God bless him and grant him peace) came with Ali, Hasan, and Husayn may God be pleased with them. I took each one of them by the hand until he entered. He brought Ali and Fatima may God be pleased with them closer and seated them in front of him, and seated Hasan and Husayn may God be pleased with them, each one of them on his thigh. Then he wrapped his garment or he said his cloak over them. Then he (may God bless him and grant him peace) recited this verse: God only desires to keep away the uncleanness from you, O people of the House, and to purify you with a thorough purification. And he said: O God, these are my family, and my family is more deserving. Abu Jaafar bin Jarir narrated it on the authority of Abdul Karim bin Abi Umair on the authority of Al-Walid bin Muslim, on the authority of Abu Amr Al-Awza’i, with a similar chain of transmission. He added at the end of it: Wathilah, may God be pleased with him, said: So I said: And I, O Messenger of God, may God bless you, am I part of your family? The Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him) said: And you are one of my family. Wathilah may God be pleased with him said: And it is one of the things I hope for most. Then he also narrated it on the authority of Abd al-A’la ibn Wasil, on the authority of al-Fadl ibn Dukayn, on the authority of Abd al-Salam ibn Harb, on the authority of Kulthum al-Maharibi, on the authority of Shaddad ibn Abi Ammar, who said: “I was sitting with Wathilah ibn al-Asqa’, may God be pleased with him, when they mentioned Ali may God be pleased with him and cursed him. When they stood up, he said: Sit so that I may tell you about the one whom they cursed. I was with the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) when Ali, Fatimah, Hasan, and Husayn may God be pleased with them came. The Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him) threw his cloak over them and said to them: “O God, these are my family. O God, remove uncleanness from them and purify them thoroughly.” I said: O Messenger of God, what about me? The Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him) said: And you? He said: By God, it is the most trustworthy deed for me. Another hadith Imam Ahmad said: Abdullah bin Numayr told us, Abdul Malik bin Abi Sulayman told us, on the authority of Ata bin Abi Rabah, who told me that he heard Umm Salamah, may God be pleased with her, mention that the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, was in her house, and Fatimah, may God be pleased with her, brought him a pot containing saffron. She entered upon him with it, and the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, said to her: Call your husband and your two sons. She said: Then Ali, Hassan, and Hussein, may God be pleased with them, came and entered upon him and sat down to eat from that saffron while he was on his bed, and beneath him, may God bless him and grant him peace, was a Khaybari cloak. She said: And I was in the room praying, and God Almighty revealed this verse: God only desires to keep away the uncleanness from you, O people of the House, and to purify you with a thorough purification. She said, may God be pleased with her: The Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, took the excess cloak and covered them with it, then he put out his hand and waved it towards the sky and said: O God, these are my family and my special ones, so keep away the uncleanness from them and purify them with a thorough purification. She said: So I put my head in the house, and I said: And I With you, O Messenger of God? He, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: You are indeed on the right path, you are indeed on the right path. In its chain of transmission is an unnamed sheikh of Ata’, but the rest of its men are trustworthy. Another chain of transmission Ibn Jarir said: Abu Kurayb narrated to us, Mus`ab ibn al-Miqdad narrated to us, Sa`id ibn Zurbi narrated to us, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Sirin, on the authority of Abu Hurayrah, on the authority of Umm Salamah, may God be pleased with her, who said: “Fatimah, may God be pleased with her, came to the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, with a pot of hers in which she had made porridge, carrying it on a plate. She placed it in front of him, may God bless him and grant him peace, and he said: ‘Where is your cousin and your two sons?’ She, may God be pleased with her, said: ‘In the house.’ He, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: ‘Call them.’ She came to Ali, may God be pleased with him, and said: ‘You and your two sons, answer the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace.’ Umm Salamah, may God be pleased with her, said: ‘When he saw them approaching, the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, reached out to a cloak that was on the bed, extended it, spread it out, and seated them on it. Then he took hold of the four corners of the cloak with his left hand and folded it over their heads. He gestured with his right hand to his Lord and said: ‘O God, these are my family, so remove impurity from them and purify them with a thorough purification.’” Another path Ibn Jarir said: Ibn Hamid told us, Abdullah bin Abdul Quddus told us, on the authority of Al-A’mash, on the authority of Hakim bin Sa’d, who said: We mentioned Ali bin Abi Talib, may God be pleased with him, to Umm Salamah, may God be pleased with her, and she said: In my house, the verse ‘God only desires to keep away the uncleanness from you, O people of the House, and to purify you with a thorough purification’ was revealed. Umm Salamah said: “The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, came to my house and said: Do not allow anyone in. Then Fatimah, may God be pleased with her, came, and I could not prevent her from entering upon her father. Then Al-Hasan, may God be pleased with him, came, and I could not prevent him from entering upon his grandfather and mother. Then Al-Husayn came, and I could not prevent him from entering upon his grandfather, may God bless him and grant him peace, and his mother, may God be pleased with them. Then Ali, may God be pleased with him, came, and I could not prevent him. So they gathered together, and the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, covered them with a cloak he was wearing, then he said: These are my family, so keep away uncleanness from them and purify them with a thorough purification. So this verse was revealed when they gathered on the carpet.” She said: “I said: O Messenger of God, and what about me?” She said: By God, he is not happy, and he said: You are on the right path. Another chain of transmission Imam Ahmad said: Muhammad ibn Ja`far told us, `Awf told us, on the authority of Abu al-Mu`addil, on the authority of `Atiyyah al-Tafawi, on the authority of his father, who said: Umm Salamah, may God be pleased with her, told him: “While the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, was in my house one day, the servant said: ‘Fatima and `Ali, may God be pleased with them, are at the door.’ She said: ‘The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said to me: ‘Get up and move away from my family.’ She said: ‘So I got up and moved away from my family in the house.’ Ali and Fatima entered, and with them were al-Hasan and al-Husayn, may God be pleased with them, and they were two young boys. He took the two boys and placed them in his lap and kissed them. He embraced `Ali, may God be pleased with him, with one hand and `Fatima, may God be pleased with her, with the other. He kissed Fatima and `Ali, and he covered them with a black cloak and said: ‘O God, to You, not to the Fire, me and my family.’ I said: ‘And what about you, O Messenger of God?’ He, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: ‘And you?’” Another chain of transmission Ibn Jarir said: Abu Kurayb told us, Al-Hasan bin Atiyah told us, Fadil bin Marzouq told us, on the authority of Atiyah, on the authority of Abu Saeed, on the authority of Umm Salamah, may God be pleased with her, who said: This verse was revealed in my house: God only desires to keep away the uncleanness from you, O people of the House, and to purify you with a thorough purification. She said: “I was sitting at the door of the house, so I said: O Messenger of God, am I not from the people of the House? He, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: You are indeed on the right path, you are from the wives of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace.” She said: “And in the house were the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, Ali, Fatimah, Al-Hasan, and Al-Hussein, may God be pleased with them.” Another way It was also narrated by Ibn Jarir on the authority of Abu Kurayb on the authority of Wakee’ on the authority of Abd al-Hamid ibn Bahram on the authority of Shahr ibn Hawshab on the authority of Umm Salamah, may God be pleased with her. Another path Ibn Jarir said: Abu Kurayb told us, Khalid bin Mukhallad told us, Musa bin Ya’qub told me, Hashim bin Hashim bin Utbah bin Abi Waqqas told me, on the authority of Abdullah bin Wahb bin Zam’ah, who said: Umm Salamah, may God be pleased with her, told me: “The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, gathered Ali, Fatimah, Al-Hasan, and Al-Hussein, may God be pleased with them, then he brought them under his garment, then he cried out to God Almighty and said: These are my family. Umm Salamah, may God be pleased with her, said: So I said: O Messenger of God, bring me in with them. So he, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: You are from my family.” Another way It was also narrated by Ibn Jarir on the authority of Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Tusi, on the authority of Abd al-Rahman ibn Salih, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Sulayman al-Asbahani, on the authority of Yahya ibn Ubayd al-Makki, on the authority of Ata’, on the authority of Umar ibn Abi Salamah, on the authority of his mother, may God be pleased with her, in a similar manner. Another hadith Ibn Jarir said: We were told by Wakee’ Muhammad ibn Bashir, on the authority of Zakariya, on the authority of Mus’ab ibn Shaybah, on the authority of Safiyyah bint Shaybah, who said: Aisha, may God be pleased with her, said: “The Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, went out one morning wearing a black hair cloak. Al-Hasan, may God be pleased with him, came and he brought him in with him. Then al-Husayn came and he brought him in with him. Then Fatimah came and he brought her in with him. Then Ali, may God be pleased with him, came and he brought him in with him. Then he, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: ‘God only desires to remove from you the impurity, O people of the House, and to purify you with a thorough purification.’” Narrated by Muslim on the authority of Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah on the authority of Muhammad ibn Bashir. Another chain of transmission Ibn Abi Hatim said: My father told us, Surayj bin Yunus Abu Al-Harith told us, Muhammad bin Yazid told us, on the authority of Al-Awam, meaning Ibn Hawshab, may God be pleased with him, on the authority of his uncle, who said: “I entered with my father upon Aisha, may God be pleased with her, and I asked her about Ali, may God be pleased with him. She said, may God be pleased with her: You are asking me about a man who was one of the most beloved people to the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, and who had his daughter under him and was the most beloved person to him? I saw the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, call Ali, Fatima, Hasan, and Husayn, may God be pleased with them, and he threw a garment over them and said: O God, these are my family, so remove impurity from them and purify them thoroughly. She said: So I approached them and said: O Messenger of God, am I one of your family? He, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: Step aside, for you are on the right path.” Another hadith Ibn Jarir said: Ibn Al-Muthanna told us, Bakr bin Yahya bin Zaban Al-Anzi told us, Mandal told us, on the authority of Al-A’mash, on the authority of Atiyyah, on the authority of Abu Sa’id, may God be pleased with him, who said: “The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: This verse was revealed about five: about me, Ali, Hassan, Hussein, and Fatimah: ‘God only desires to remove from you the uncleanness, O people of the House, and to purify you with a thorough purification.’” It was previously mentioned that Fadil bin Marzuq narrated it on the authority of Atiyyah, on the authority of Abu Sa’id, on the authority of Umm Salamah, may God be pleased with her, as previously mentioned. Ibn Abi Hatim narrated from the hadith of Harun bin Sa’d Al-Ajli, on the authority of Atiyyah, on the authority of Abu Sa’id, may God be pleased with him, as a narration that ends with the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace. And God Almighty knows best. Another hadith Ibn Jarir said: Ibn Al-Muthanna told us, Abu Bakr Al-Hanafi told us, Bakir bin Mismar told us: I heard Amer bin Saad, may God be pleased with him, say: Saad, may God be pleased with him, said: “The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said when the revelation came down to him, so he took Ali, his two sons, and Fatima, may God be pleased with them, and brought them under his garment, then he said: O Lord, these are my family and my household.” Another hadith Muslim said in his Sahih: Zuhair bin Harb and Shuja’ bin Mukhallad told me, on the authority of Ibn Ulayyah. Zuhair said: Ismail bin Ibrahim told us, Abu Hayyan told me, Yazid bin Hibban told me: I, Husayn bin Sabra, and Umar bin Maslama went to Zayd bin Arqam, may God be pleased with him. When we sat down with him, Husayn said to him: You have found much good, O Zayd. You saw the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, and heard his hadith. You fought with him and prayed behind him. You have found much good, O Zayd. Tell us, Zaid, what you heard from the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him). He said: O son of my brother, by God, I have grown old and my time has passed, and I have forgotten some of what I used to remember from the Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him). So accept what I have told you, and do not burden me with what I have not told you. Then he said: “The Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) stood up among us one day to deliver a sermon at a watering place called Khumm, between Mecca and Medina. He praised God and extolled Him, and preached and reminded. Then he said: As for what follows, O people, I am only a human being. Soon a messenger from my Lord will come to me and I will respond. I am leaving among you two weighty things: The first is the Book of God, in which is guidance and light, so take the Book of God and hold fast to it.” He urged people to adhere to the Book of God and encouraged them to adhere to it. Then he said: “And the people of my household. I remind you of God regarding the people of my household. I remind you of God regarding the people of my household,” three times. Husayn said to him: And who are the people of his household, Zaid? Aren’t his women among his household?
